snippet.title: AVPR: Aliens vs Predator - Requiem: Combat Evolved Gameplay
snippet.description:
This was a flash game where a big monstrous alien would climb its way up to tall buildings and start many rampages as possible. From biting people's head off to destroying tanks and choppers. This game was developed by none other than 20th Century Studios, formerly known as 20th Century Fox at the time. For those who haven't see the movie, it's available on Hulu for subscription, and on Tubi for free. Subscribe for more missed computer games!!
